title: fix: Setup form help speaks to an administrator; queue pages, mail status banner and test toast read in Chinese
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgAb97yDcvm73kZUzyhhNWsN)_

domain:server#6 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXCS98uhsFQYk64epE

Refs #30208 (rows 1, 2, 3, 7, 8)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n -I -E "fail-closed at resolution|half-open \[from, until\)|graph semantics|root of tenant|HRIS sync|upstream HRIS|expanded by graph|When true, every member|When true, the user|task/run attribution|No mail leaves this machine|Sent test email" -- skills` on `e205cf31` answers 0 lines; no published skill sentence quotes the replaced help or the mail status text.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup 里「新建权限集分配 / 岗位分配」「外出委派规则」「新建业务单元」「编辑组织」「用户」表单的字段说明改成管理员能看懂的话（去掉 fail-closed、半开区间、图谱、Null、HRIS、「为 true 时」等，改为「开启后…」）；「队列」「队列成员」两页补上中文；「邮件投递」顶部状态横幅和「发送测试邮件」的提示在中文界面下显示中文。
- 为什么改：真实用户走查 Setup 时，这些说明在描述实现而不是告诉管理员该填什么；队列两页整页英文（按钮显示「新建Queue」）；邮件页横幅和测试提示是英文。
- 风险与回滚：只改服务端下发的文字，不改任何字段名、选项值或行为；唯一的接口变化是设置动作处理函数多收一个可选的 `locale`，已有处理函数不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/live-transport-status.ts`（中英文案表与按语言取文案），`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-routes.ts` 与 `settings-service.ts` 的 `runAction`（动作路由把请求语言交给处理函数），`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts`（队列两个对象进翻译包）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/mail-log-provider.pin.test.ts`，预期 13 条全过，其中 5 条是中文横幅与测试提示。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Rows 1–3: field help in administrator wording (English source and zh-CN).** Text only; no field name, key, option value or behaviour moves.

| Form | Field | Before (zh-CN) | After (zh-CN) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 权限集分配 / 岗位分配 | `valid_from` | 在解析时以 fail-closed 方式强制执行 | 到时即生效，无需等待任何定时任务 |
| 权限集分配 / 岗位分配 | `valid_until` | 半开区间 [from, until)，UTC；智能体授权必填 | 到此时间即失效（按 UTC 计）；授予 AI 智能体的分配必须填写 |
| 权限集分配 | `reason` | 智能体授权在此记录任务/运行归属 | 授予 AI 智能体时，请写明它为哪项任务获得授权 |
| 审批委派 | `valid_until` | 半开区间 [from, until) | 规则到此时间即失效（按 UTC 计） |
| 业务单元 | `kind` | 不会改变图谱语义 | 仅用于分类和报表，不会改变该单元在组织中的位置和覆盖范围 |
| 业务单元 | `parent_business_unit_id` | Null 表示租户根节点 | 留空表示顶级单元 |
| 业务单元 | `active` | 为 false 时，图谱查询不会展开该业务单元成员 | 关闭后即停用该单元：授予该单元或其上级单元的共享等访问权限，将不再覆盖其成员及下级单元 |
| 业务单元 | `effective_from` / `effective_to` / `external_ref` | HRIS 同步 / 上游 HRIS | 通常由 HR 系统同步填写 / 在 HR 系统中的编号 |
| 组织 | `require_mfa` | 为 true 时 | 开启后 |
| 用户 | `banned`, `must_change_password` | 为 true 时；403 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED | 开启后；用户必须先修改密码才能继续使用 |

The English sources (`*.object.ts`) say the same in English; `en.*.generated.ts` follow by extract. The `active` sentence states what `BusinessUnitGraphService` does with an inactive unit (contributes no members and stops the descent into its subtree, `plugin-sharing/src/business-unit-graph.ts`); `must_change_password` names the admin create, import and reset paths that set it (`plugin-auth` `admin-user-endpoints.ts`, `admin-import-users.ts`).

**Row 7: the 队列 and 队列成员 pages.** `plugin-sharing`'s extract config now lists `SysQueue` and `SysQueueMember` beside its three sharing objects (the `bundle-ownership` list follows). The extract added both objects to every bundle; zh-CN is written by hand (队列 / 队列成员, every field, help, the member-type options and the two list-view names). ja-JP and es-ES carry the extract's English fill, except the member-type options, which reuse the renderings `sys_record_share` / `sys_sharing_rule` already use in those bundles (the package's `recipient-vocabulary-consistency` pin requires one rendering per option key).

**Row 8: Setup → Email.**

- `plugin-email`: `describeLiveMailTransport(source, locale?)` writes the banner from a per-language copy table (`MAIL_DELIVERY_COPY`, en and zh-CN; `mailDeliveryCopy` resolves exact, then by language, else English), the mechanism `service-settings`' currency lock already uses for its live status. The plugin's live-status provider passes the `locale` the settings service already hands it. The `mail/test` handler writes its sent, failed and log-only answers from the same table.
- `service-settings`: `SettingsActionHandler`'s input gains an optional `locale`; `runAction(namespace, actionId, payload, ctx, display?)` passes `display.locale` to the handler; the POST action route passes `requestLocaleOf(req)`, the same reading the GET route gives the live status. The locale stays out of `ctx`. An existing handler compiles and behaves unchanged.

## Tests

One pin file per row, plus a route pin:

- `plugin-security/src/translations/assignment-help-wording.test.ts`: served zh-CN (`SecurityTranslations`) and the English source of `valid_from` / `valid_until` / `reason` on both assignment objects carry no `fail-closed`, interval notation or `agent grants` / 智能体授权, and the zh-CN help is Chinese.
- `plugin-approvals/src/translations/delegation-window-wording.test.ts`: `sys_approval_delegation.valid_until`, same shape.
- `platform-objects/src/identity/setup-form-admin-wording.test.ts`: served zh-CN (`SetupAppTranslations`) and the English source of the nine business unit, organization and user fields carry no graph vocabulary, null literal, `HRIS`, boolean literal or HTTP status code.
- `plugin-sharing/src/translations/queue-pages-zh-cn.test.ts`: the served zh-CN bundle names 队列 / 队列成员 and translates every field label, help and member-type option.
- `plugin-email/src/mail-log-provider.pin.test.ts` (the existing Setup → Email harness, new top-level `describe`): zh-CN banner for the out-of-the-box and the delivering transport, the zh-CN test toast, the zh-CN log-only warning, and a control (`fr-FR` answers English).
- `service-settings/src/settings-routes.test.ts`: the POST action route hands the handler `zh-CN` from `Accept-Language`, `undefined` without one, and not in `ctx`.

Red on `main` (the pin commit `0f390750`, before the fix): security 10 failed / 2 passed, approvals 2/2 failed, platform-objects 18/18 failed, sharing 4/4 failed, email 4 failed / 9 passed (the control passed), settings routes 1 failed / 34 passed.

Ablation (once, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit x1, restored blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): with the live-status provider calling `describeLiveMailTransport(this.service)` again (the locale dropped), exactly the two zh-CN statement pins go red, 2 failed / 11 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- **No closing keyword:** the dispatch's How section spells a closing line, its rulings say `Refs`; this PR follows the rulings, so merging leaves the card open for rows 5 and 6 (row 5 needs a settings shape; row 6 waits on the maintainer).
- **ja-JP and es-ES are not re-translated here.** Their leaves for the help changed in rows 1–3 still translate the old English source (for example es-ES `valid_from` still says "modo fail-closed"); they are legacy-trusted (no provenance record), so they keep serving that text. The queue objects arrive there as English fills, recorded in each locale's `source-hashes` file. The seat's serial note puts those two languages with the pending seven-language pass on these packages.
- **Mail copy is en and zh-CN.** ja-JP and es-ES callers get the English banner and toast, as before. The test handler's input refusals (`SMTP host is required — nothing was sent.`, `api_key is required`, an unsupported provider, a transport that cannot be built) stay English; only the sent, failed and log-only answers moved.
- **Not touched, same class, outside these rows' forms:** `sys_setting` / `sys_platform_setting` `encrypted` and `locked` help still say 「为 true 时」 (an internal store, not a Setup form); `sys_user_position.business_unit_id` help names `readScope/writeScope`.
- `mail.manifest.ts` (`plugin-email` and `service-settings`) is not touched (another lane's card edits it).
- **`require_mfa` and PR #30529:** that open PR (another seat's card on the same field) rewrites this help to add that the requirement needs two-factor on for the deployment, keeping "When true". This PR's help keeps that sentence beside the administrator wording, in English and zh-CN, so whichever lands second resolves the textual conflict by taking this text; #30529's pins (`two-factor authentication on for this deployment`, `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true` in every locale) hold against it. ja-JP and es-ES for that field are #30529's.

## Verification

<details><summary>Package suites and typechecks (head e205cf31; the later main merge brought one ui-only commit)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/PKG test` and `typecheck` for service-settings, platform-objects, plugin-security, plugin-approvals, plugin-sharing, plugin-email: all exit 0 under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0). plugin-sharing 66 files / 1409 tests after the ja-JP / es-ES option fix.
- `pnpm check:i18n`: all ten bundle sets in sync. `pnpm i18n:extract`: byte-identical.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed TypeScript files: exit 0. `pnpm lint` (repository-wide) on `7e4a3272`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `f63ad0b2` (after the `origin/main` merge) derived 66 commands over 32 changed paths. Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran`: 66 derived, 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

- 64 exited 0 on the first pass.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads every package's `dist`, and only this card's closure was built). NOT MEASURED here; CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- `pnpm check:i18n-stale-fill`: exit 1 on the first pass. It found `sys_approval_delegation.valid_until.help` in ja-JP and es-ES still holding the byte-identical English fill of the old source. Both now carry the fill of the new source (recorded by the extract), and the gate exits 0 on `07d639c3` and on the final head.

After the union two small commits landed: `07d639c3` (those two fills) and `7e4a3272` (`require_mfa` help, see Acceptance notes). The changed-path set grew from 32 to 36 paths; the derived gate family did not move (the same 66 commands). Re-run on `7e4a3272`: `pnpm check:i18n` exit 0, `pnpm check:i18n-stale-fill` exit 0, `pnpm i18n:extract` byte-identical, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` 112 files / 1544 tests, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test` (on `07d639c3`) 112 files / 1471 tests.

</details>
